viewing_check: Armitage estimate $50-70, current bid $20 (re-checked 9 Nov 2026; closes 11 Nov 2026 2:49pm; 22% premium). Seven large figures, some sold 'as is': check bases for chips and repairs. Terapeak AU (3 yr) shows single Shiwan figures sell A$5-77, typically A$20-45 for 18-25cm figures; a group of 5 made A$140.81 (Oct 2024, one bid) and 16 figures made A$40 hammer at Theodore Bruce (Aug 2026, condition loss). Prices 2024-2026, flat. Seven large figures in good condition might resell for roughly A$150-250 piecemeal, but heavy fragile pottery is costly to post and slow to list.
